grok.match_rules:
traceback_format (%{_python_prefix}|%{_datadog_prefix})\s+%{_message_with_keyvalue}Traceback \(most recent call last\):(?s)\s*%{data:error.stack}
python_format (%{_python_prefix}|%{_datadog_prefix})\s+%{_message_with_keyvalue}
python_fallback %{date("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss','SSS"):timestamp}\s+%{word:levelname}\s+%{_message_with_keyvalue}((\n|\t)%{data:error.stack})?
